message.content: I have the full problem text, kernel source, and file listing already; no re-reading needed. The kernel is a packed real FFT: it treats consecutive real FP16 pairs as complex values, runs an in-register radix-2 DIF complex FFT of size M=N/2 in FP64, bit-reverses, then reconstructs the real spectrum via the standard split formula. I traced the twiddle table logic (cos via quadrant folding, sine via cos offset by 64) and the reconstruction/Nyquist/DC special cases, and they match the standard formulas. Let me record the description model with the risk surfaces worth probing.
